subject: Hybrid trace shim pilot — LangChain & LlamaIndex adapter collaboration
messages:
From: Alex Tran <alex.tran@promptweave.com>

Cc: Samir Shah <samir@chaincraft.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: lightweight tracing adapter for LangChain + LlamaIndex

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro last month — following up with a short proposal. PromptWeave has built a compact tracing shim that hooks into LangChain and LlamaIndex call stacks to emit standardized spans (prompt id, model variant, token counts, latency, rerank deltas). We've successfully piloted this with two ISVs and one enterprise customer; the adapter is purposely lightweight to avoid per-token overhead and supports both HTTP and SDK integrations.

We think a joint pilot could: 
- Provide Redwood Console with consistent trace payloads from popular SDKs
- Validate end-to-end sampling and correlate with Redwood token/cost telemetry
- Surface prompt-level regressions tied to model rollouts in both LangChain and LlamaIndex flows

Attached is a short spec and a proposed pilot SOW (two-week technical proof + one month limited production trace ingestion). If this sounds useful, can we schedule a technical sync next week to align on acceptance criteria and data retention?

Attachments: promptweave-trace-spec.md (text), promptweave-pilot-sow.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Alex Tran

Alex / Samir — great sync today. Confirming next steps and acceptance criteria so we have a single source of truth: 

Mutual Action Plan (confirmed):
- Deliverables from PromptWeave: sample trace payloads (3 examples), instrumented LangChain adapter build (npm/py wheel), simple toggle flag for sampling and PII redaction.
- Deliverables from Redwood: temporary ingestion stream, sample Redwood Console dashboard, 1 test customer for limited prod ingestion (opt-in).
- Acceptance criteria: spans contain span_id, prompt_hash, model_name, token_in/out, latency_ms; sampling toggle works without increasing median latency > 5%; no PII in any span fields.
- Timeline: Tech sync -> 1 week; sandbox run -> week 2; opt-in limited prod -> weeks 3–6.
- Commercials: pilot engineering fee $15k (PromptWeave invoice to Redwood), ingestion cost covered by PromptWeave up to 1M-token equivalent; conversion options discussed in SOW.

I've attached the redwood-draft-sow-v1.pdf and included the DocuSign link for the pilot SOW. Please review and sign if the MAP looks right.
